title: Congo/PROs Technical Architect
description:
To have your Candidate considered, please enter your current location and confirmation of relocation, if not local, in the Supplier Notes.

Top Skill(s):
1. Solution Architecture & Design — leading discovery, defining blueprints, and governing technical decisions
2. Implementation & Technical Delivery — hands-on Conga/PROS configuration, Salesforce development, and API integrations
3. Pricing & Revenue Optimization (PROS) — AI-driven pricing models, price tables, and deal guidance
4. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership — client-facing ownership, team mentoring, and pre-sales support
5. Quality, Governance & Testing — UAT, QA standards, platform upgrades, and compliance

Job Description/ Responsibilities:
We are seeking a seasoned Technical Architect with deep expertise in Conga CPQ/CLM and PROS Smart CPQ platforms. This individual will lead end-to-end solutioning, architecture design, and implementation for complex configure-price-quote and revenue optimization engagements. You will work closely with business stakeholders, sales operations, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-performance CPQ solutions that drive revenue growth.

Solution Architecture & Design
• Design and own end-to-end CPQ architecture using Conga CPQ (Apttus) and/or PROS Smart CPQ, ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements.
• Lead discovery workshops with business stakeholders to capture quoting, pricing, and contract lifecycle requirements.
• Define solution blueprints, data models, integration patterns, and configuration standards.
• Evaluate trade-offs between configuration, customization, and third-party integrations to recommend optimal approaches.
• Govern technical design decisions across project teams, ensuring adherence to platform best practices.

Implementation & Technical Delivery
• Configure and customize Conga CPQ / PROS modules including product catalog, pricing waterfalls, guided selling, approval workflows, and document generation.
• Develop Apex classes, triggers, Visualforce pages, and Lightning Web Components to extend Salesforce-based CPQ functionality.
• Build and maintain REST/SOAP API integrations between CPQ platforms and ERP, CRM, and e-commerce systems (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce).
• Lead data migration efforts including product, pricing, and contract data from legacy systems.
• Perform code reviews and enforce development standards across the delivery team.

Pricing & Revenue Optimization (PROS)
• Architect PROS pricing intelligence solutions including AI-driven price optimization, deal scoring, and dynamic pricing models.
• Configure PROS pricing tables, price lists, segments, and guidance recommendations aligned to commercial strategy.
• Collaborate with pricing strategy teams to translate business rules into PROS pricing algorithms and workflows.
• Enable PROS analytics dashboards to support sales performance monitoring and margin management.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for CPQ/CLM engagements with clients and internal teams.
• Mentor junior developers and functional consultants on CPQ configuration, best practices, and coding standards.
• Collaborate with Project Managers to create and refine technical estimates, project plans, and risk logs.
• Present architecture proposals, technical designs, and project status updates to C-level and VP stakeholders.
• Support pre-sales activities including RFP responses, solution demonstrations, and effort estimation.

Quality, Governance & Testing
• Define and enforce QA standards, including unit testing frameworks and regression test plans for CPQ solutions.
• Lead UAT planning and execution in coordination with business stakeholders.
• Manage technical debt and platform upgrades in line with Conga and PROS release schedules.
• Ensure solutions comply with data security, privacy (GDPR/CCPA), and audit requirements.

Experience
• 8+ years of enterprise software implementation experience
• 5+ years hands-on with Conga CPQ (Apttus) or PROS Smart CPQ
• 3+ years in a Solution/Technical Architect capacity
• Proven delivery of large-scale CPQ projects ($1M+ engagements)

Technical Skills
• Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL)
• REST/SOAP API integration patterns
• Conga Composer, Conga Sign, or Conga Contracts
• PROS Pricing & Configure modules
• ERP integration: SAP S/4HANA or Oracle

Certifications (Preferred)
• Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I/II
• Salesforce Certified Application Architect
• Conga Certified CPQ Specialist
• PROS Certified Implementation Specialist

Soft Skills
• Excellent communication with executive audiences
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Ability to manage competing priorities in agile delivery
• Collaborative leadership and team mentoring

Nice to Have
• Experience with Zuora or Ironclad CLM
• Knowledge of CPQ-to-ERP order management flows
• Familiarity with Agile / SAFe delivery frameworks
• Exposure to AI/ML pricing models
• Multi-cloud CRM architecture experience
• Revenue recognition knowledge (ASC 606)

This role analyzes the current quality heatmap, identifies systemic improvement areas, and drives adoption through enablement—training, workshops, playbooks and flyers, community of practice, and focused hackathons. The strategist ensures quality is treated as a shared, end-to-end responsibility across Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, Security, Data, and Business Operations—not just the testing team.

You'll own the roadmap for enterprise quality maturity: enabling end‐to‐end cross‐platform testing, contract testing, KPI/SLA measurement, test environment alignment, robust automation practices, and AI‐enabled accelerators with governance. Deep domain understanding across Customer Onboarding, Underwriting, Policy Administration & Servicing, Claims, Compensation/Commissions, Correspondence/Print, General Ledger, and Actuarial workflows is essential to design quality practices that respect interdependencies and regulatory constraints.

What You'll Do (Roles & Responsibilities)
1) Enterprise QE Strategy & Governance
  • Define and maintain the enterprise Quality Strategy, operating model, and guardrails aligned to business objectives and regulatory obligations.
  • Build and maintain a living Quality Heatmap across domains, systems, and squads—highlighting hotspots, impediments, and prioritized interventions.
  • Establish and chair the QE Council: cross‐functional governance with Product, Architecture, DevOps, Security, Data, Compliance, and Business stakeholders.
  • Create and enforce standards for definition of ready/done, testability requirements, non‐functional quality gates, and quality risk sign‐off practices.
  • Institutionalize shift‐left practices: acceptance criteria quality, contract tests, data readiness, accessibility, performance SLOs, security scanning, and compliance earlier in the lifecycle.
2) End‐to‐End & Cross‐Platform Quality Enablement (Insurance Value Chain)
  • Orchestrate end‐to‐end journey testing spanning onboarding → underwriting → policy issuance → servicing → claims → compensation → correspondence → finance/GL → actuarial, including batch and downstream data feeds.
  • Define integration contracts and drive contract testing adoption to reduce environment coupling and accelerate parallel testing

title: Labguru Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Labguru Analyst (Contractor) to support the implementation of our Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) on the Labguru platform. This is a hands-on configuration and delivery role — you will work directly with internal stakeholders to design, build, test, and deploy ELN templates and workflows that meet our scientific and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate has direct experience configuring Labguru or a comparable ELN/LIMS platform, understands laboratory processes in a life science or pharma context, and can manage iterative delivery cycles from requirements gathering through go-live.

Scope of Work

1. ELN Configuration & Template Development
• Design and build ELN templates within Labguru tailored to laboratory workflows and use cases
• Configure workflows within the platform to support laboratory processes end-to-end
• Ensure all configurations align with business requirements and applicable regulatory considerations
• Support iterative design, testing, and refinement cycles throughout the implementation lifecycle

2. Requirement Translation
• Collaborate with internal scientific and operational stakeholders to gather and translate requirements into Labguru configurations
• Participate in workshops, design sessions, and working groups to ensure alignment on platform setup
• Bridge the gap between scientific needs and technical ELN capabilities, offering best-practice guidance

3. Testing & Validation Support
• Assist in planning and executing system testing including unit, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
• Document test cases, track defects, and implement updates or fixes as issues are identified
• Support validation activities to meet regulatory and quality requirements where applicable

4. Documentation
• Develop and maintain comprehensive configuration documentation throughout the implementation
• Support the creation of user guides, SOPs, and training materials for end users and administrators
• Ensure documentation is kept current through iterative changes and post-deployment updates

5. Deployment Support
• Assist with go-live preparation including final configuration checks, data migration support, and readiness reviews
• Provide post-deployment stabilization support to address issues and ensure smooth adoption
• Serve as a point of contact during the hypercare period following launch

Qualifications

Required
• Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Labguru — including template and workflow development
• Background in life sciences, biotech, pharma, or a related laboratory environment
• Experience participating in ELN or LIMS implementation projects from requirements through deployment
• Ability to translate scientific and operational requirements into platform configurations
• Strong communication skills with the ability to facilitate workshops and engage cross-functional stakeholders
• Experience with system testing, UAT support, and defect resolution
• Proven ability to produce clear configuration documentation and user-facing materials

Preferred
• Familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, or other relevant regulatory frameworks
• Experience with Labguru's workflow automation editor and API
• Prior work in a contractor or consulting delivery model
• Knowledge of data integrity principles in a regulated lab environment

title: Principal / Lead AI ML Engineer – Knowledge Graphs & GenA
description:
Experience Required
10+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering, with strong depth in knowledge graphs, unstructured data processing, and generative AI systems.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced AI/ML Engineer with a strong foundation in knowledge graph engineering and generative AI to design, build, and scale intelligent data pipelines that transform large-scale unstructured data into enterprise-grade knowledge graphs.
The ideal candidate will have deep experience in ontology modeling, entity resolution, probabilistic pattern matching, and agentic knowledge base enrichment, combined with strong expertise in LLMs/SMLs, fine-tuning pipelines, and graph-based reasoning systems.
This role involves architecting and delivering production-grade AI systems that integrate LLMs with knowledge graphs, enabling contextual reasoning, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation at scale.
Key Responsibilities
Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engineering
• Design, build, and maintain enterprise-scale Knowledge Graphs from large volumes of unstructured data (text, documents, logs, PDFs, web data).
• Create and evolve ontologies using RDF/OWL, including:
o Entity extraction and linking
o Entity resolution and disambiguation
o Probabilistic pattern matching
o Ontology alignment across heterogeneous data sources
• Implement semantic modeling for complex domains to support reasoning, discovery, and analytics.

Agentic Knowledge Base Enrichment
• Develop agentic AI systems for:
o Automated data gap identification
o Knowledge base enrichment and validation
o Continuous learning and self improving graph pipelines
• Build workflows that combine LLM reasoning with graph traversal and inference.

AI/ML & GenAI Systems
• Design and implement AI/ML pipelines integrating:
o Large Language Models (LLMs)
o Small Language Models (SMLs)
o Reasoning and task specific models
• Build fine tuning pipelines, including:
o Dataset generation and curation
o Training and fine tuning (SFT, PEFT, adapters)
o Evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment
• Apply prompt engineering, RAG, and hybrid LLM + Knowledge Graph (GraphRAG) techniques for contextual intelligence.

Anomaly Detection & Analytics
• Develop anomaly detection systems on top of knowledge graph data at scale.
• Apply graph analytics, embeddings, and ML techniques to detect:
o Semantic inconsistencies
o Behavioral anomalies
o Data quality and relationship drift

Data & ML Engineering
• Build robust data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich, and publish knowledge graph data.
• Implement scalable ML systems using Python for:
o Model development
o Training and tuning
o Inference and deployment

Technical Skills & Expertise
Core AI/ML
• Strong AI/ML engineering background with deep expertise in:
o Python
o Model development, training, tuning, and deployment
• Extensive hands on experience with:
o Large Language Models (LLMs)
o Small Language Models (SMLs)
o Generative AI and reasoning models
o Text generation, summarization, and semantic search workflows
Knowledge Graph Technologies
• Strong experience with:
o Neo4j, GraphDB
o RDF, OWL
o Cypher, SPARQL
• Proven ability to implement:
o Entity linking and resolution
o Semantic search
o Relationship mapping and inference

GenAI Frameworks & Tooling
• Experience building GenAI systems using:
o LangChain, LangGraph
o LlamaIndex
o OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
o Vector databases such as Pinecone and FAISS

MLOps & LLMOps
• Strong experience in MLOps and LLMOps, including:
o MLflow, Azure ML, Datadog
o CI/CD automation for ML systems
o Observability, logging, and tracing
o Model performance monitoring and drift detection
• Experience deploying and operating AI systems in production environments.

Cloud & Scalability
• Experience building and optimizing AI/ML and graph pipelines either of any on:
o Azure
o AWS
o GCP
• Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and performance optimization.
________________________________________
Client is looking for candidates who have experience in building:
• Ontology from large scale data (requires experience in entity resolution, probabilistic pattern matching)
• Agentic knowledge-base enrichment (automated data gap identification, and data enrichment)
• Anomaly detection on top of knowledge graph data at scale
• Fine tuning pipeline (including dataset generation, tuning, evaluation, deployment) for small language models and reasoning models

title: IBM Workload Scheduler Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled (3–5+ years dedicated experience administering) IBM Workload Scheduler (IWS) Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our enterprise batch scheduling infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end administration of the IWS environment hosted primarily on Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). This role requires a strong blend of IWS expertise, Linux system administration, and scripting to ensure high availability and seamless execution of critical business workloads.

Responsibilities
1. Administer Production IBM Workload Scheduler (aka Tivoli Workload Scheduler) environment with 28,000 unique daily jobs across ~350,000 daily job runs, 44 servers, and three other change control environments.
2. Administer, install, configure, and patch/upgrade IWS components (Master Domain Manager, Dynamic Agents, Dynamic Pool, Dynamic Workload Console).
3. Work with Product Owner on communicating work streams in Jira.
4. Manage job promotions using Workload Application Template-based processes, ensuring platform stability checks for each promotion.
5. Manage change control across four separate environments, enforcing standards and policies.
6. Maintain and promote 99.17% Production platform uptime per calendar month (excluding planned outages and maintenance windows) using SOPs, DevOps tools, and disciplined change control.
7. Communicate platform improvements to a user community of ~500 developers and data engineers.
8. Production consists of 44 servers across MDM, DWC, and dynamic agents.
9. Resolve complex job failures, performance bottlenecks, agent issues, and infrastructure issues.
10. Advise on complex job scheduling design questions for the scheduling support team.
11. Monitor scheduler health, manage database maintenance, perform backup/disaster recovery, and conduct monthly failovers.
12. Define and maintain security policies, user authorizations, and authentication for the DWC.
13. Respond to cybersecurity vulnerability assessments and regulatory audit inquiries (including PCI).
14. Design and implement Ansible automation and self-healing mechanisms to reduce unplanned outages.
15. Coordinate with offshore teams performing SOPs during non-working hours.
16. Script in Python using the IWS REST API.

Required Technical Skills
1. Strong experience with IBM Workload Scheduler architecture, especially Dynamic Workload Broker, V10.1+, high availability of MDMs managing Fault Tolerant Agent and Dynamic Agent architectures.
1. Strong conceptual understanding of Master Domain Manager (MDM), Backup MDM (BMDM), Dynamic Workload Console (DWC), Fault Tolerant Agent (FTA), Dynamic Agent (DA).
2. Strong grasp of conman CLI to monitor and control production plan, check job/job stream/resource status.
3. Strong grasp of composer CLI to define, modify and extract scheduling objects.
4. Strong grasp of planman CLI to control pre-production plan and GUI mirroring.
5. Strong grasp of lifecycle of daily production planning process, phases of JNextPlan/FINAL.
6. Proficiency in navigating the DWC web-based GUI to monitor workloads, manage user access security, and define scheduling objects.
7. Experience installing IWS components, applying Fix Packs, and Interim Fixes.
8. Troubleshooting with logs under TWSDATA/stdlist, adjusting trace level for netman, batchman, writer, mailman, etc.
2. Strong experience with IBM WebSphere Liberty.
1. Strong grasp of reading messages.log, traces.log, FFDC logs.
2. Strong grasp of configuring JVM heap sizes.
3. Strong grasp of configuring tracing scope, tracing levels, tracing retention, and trace strings.
3. Strong experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8+.
1. Deep familiarity with bash/shell commands for text processing (grep, awk, sed), file manipulation, and system navigation.
2. Ability to manage, start, stop, and troubleshoot SystemD services using systemctl and journalctl for IWS agents and MDM.
3. Managing user accounts, groups, service accounts and deep knowledge of Linux file permissions (chmod, chown, ACL on local filesystems and NFS).
4. Ability to monitor system performance using top, htop, vmstat, iostat, sar to troubleshoot bottlenecks and platform unresponsiveness.
5. Understanding of Logical Volume Manager (LVM) and filesystem usage.
6. Checking TCP port availability, firewall rules (firewalld/iptables), and connectivity between MDM and Dynamic Agents using netstat, ss, ping, curl, etc.
7. Managing SSL/TLS certificates, private keystores, public truststores, and working with Certificate Authority.
4. Strong experience with scripting (Bash Shell, Python, etc.) for automation.
5. Understanding of networking principles.
6. Understanding of basic Oracle database administration, enough to troubleshoot with DBAs to prove when an issue is in Oracle.
1. Understanding of basic SQL to query job metadata.
2.1. Understanding of checking database connectivity.
7. Understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure.
8. Experience with using secrets manager (CyberArk PPM, Hashicorp Vault, or similar).
